about: Filo starter brand bank. Merged from: FILO Quality Fashion Brand Research V1 (73 records, 20 Oct 2026), FILO 500 Style-Led Brand Discovery Bank V2 (500 names, 20 Oct 2026) and Filo's brand directory (claude/filo-brand-directory.json). Only the 23 first-wave brands are approved (Brooklyn delegated the first-wave picks on 20 Oct 2026); every other brand is approved=false until she approves it in Filo Studio. Approving a brand never approves its products. research_status follows the V2 labels: priority_screen (has quality research or directory facts, screen first), discovery_lead (style fit only, not yet quality or ethics checked), resale_source (judge each listing, not the platform), remove. Style fit and quality evidence are separate: style_led=true means the brand is in the style-led discovery list; evidence_level comes from the V1 research. V2 style pools are directional and may not match where a brand is based or made. No URLs were invented: brands without a verified official site carry that flag.
